_readme.discover: Energy silently granted the FIRST time a user reaches a planet in the Space Explorer. On purpose, this is never shown or promised anywhere in the UI - it is a surprise reward.
_readme.share: Energy granted the first time a user shares a snapshot taken on a planet.
_readme.how_to_customize: Edit the two numbers above to whatever you want. Changes take effect on the next page refresh - no server restart needed. Rewards are counted per unique planet, so a user cannot farm the same planet twice.
